attrs.evidence: Replaces R5's binary EMB-KERNEL-LOCATION framing, on GPT-5.6's finding. A capability is typically supported by several of these at once and by more than one path, so 'internalized or externalized' is not a partition of the cases — it is a description of the two extremes of a lattice. The graph formulation makes the extremes fall out rather than be assumed: fully externalized means every support path crosses a parent-controlled node; fully internalized means no authorized cut disables the capability; hybrid is everything in between, and hybrid is where deleting the visible skill file leaves the competence intact.
attrs.prior_art: GPT-5.6, round-5 Mosaic audit §12. Generalises EMB-KERNEL (Fable), which asked for the minimal persistent artifact set without asking where it may live.
attrs.statement: A capability's continuity is a property of a SUPPORT GRAPH — weights, prompt, memory, code, tools, services, cached artifacts, descendants — and a continuity kernel is a minimal support set sufficient for the capability under a replacement contract.
